row.title: One reader for both VENDORED_FROM forms (US-31-R63)
row.body: workers/tools/vendor.py parse_vendored reads the JSON and the text form, keyed by the path inside the vendor directory; tenant_sync.py reads through it and revendor writes the form the tenant uses. Proven by node --test workers/tools/spec-31-vendor.test.mjs.
